title: Present health identifiers as options relative to foundational ID
requirements:
- State the required outcome as reliable cross-system identification, achievable by national, federated or multiple linked identifiers
- Describe how health identity integrates with, or transitions to, foundational ID services, including where health may seed foundational ID
- Cite the exact WHO source for the three HUID models and say whether they are adapted
- Define authoritative sources per attribute rather than assuming one foundational system for all demographics
- Prefer identifiers linked to, not derived from, foundational IDs; address assurance under Model B and propagation under Model C
- Reconcile 'does not duplicate foundational data' with the minimum demographics the registry must retain
- Allow provisional identifiers at registration and capture of identifier types only when they exist
- Base storage of foundational identifiers on legal authority and necessity, not consent alone
